summary: Closed learning loop with self-authored skills (Hermes Agent: after a complex task of five or more tool calls, distill procedure, failure points, and verification steps into a portable skill document; refine the skill during later use; nudge the agent to persist knowledge between tasks; three-layer memory — persistent notes always loaded, full-text session search with summarization, skills library as procedural memory; dialectic user modelling from the tension between stated preference and observed correction; skills as portable files in an open format) + event-sourced partner attribution (OpenPartner: raw events immutable, attribution a re-derivable view; four attribution models — last_click, first_click, linear, position — selectable per campaign and re-derivable from the same raw tables; identity stitching with late-binding backlog attribution; two-tier commissions with a human review queue where reversal is a first-class operation; spec generated from validators with a drift test; round-trippable CSV/JSON/SQL export) + AssetGate ideas only (two-gate transfer shape, modular compliance checks, Merkle distribution with pull-payment claims, corporate controls as named audited operations — NOT gated, no LICENSE file). Patterns restated in our own words only; no code, no network/wallet/signing/payment/API-key code, no benchmark, speed, deployment, audit, star-count, or pricing claims as fact.
